basic_details.job_title: NAM Kerala Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 7 DEO, Full Time Sweeper and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National AYUSH Mission Keralam (NAM Kerala) has announced 7 vacancies for State Quality Consultant, Procurement Officer, HMIS Manager, Content Creator, Data Entry Operator, and Full Time Sweeper posts on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can submit their offline application in a sealed envelope, either directly or through post, to The State Mission Director on or before 27 October 2026. Qualifications and monthly pay vary by post, with pay ranging from Rs. 12,600 per month to Rs. 40,000 per month. qualification.details: State Quality Consultant: Master of Hospital Administration (MHA) from a recognized University or equivalent. Experience: 2-3 years of experience in hospital quality improvement. Age Limit: Maximum 40 years as on 01-10-2026. Desirable: Prior experience in Central/State Government employment and knowledge of IT/Computer applications including MS Office, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint. Procurement Officer: MBA from recognized University or equivalent. Experience: 2-3 years as a Procurement Officer and/or in e-Tender processing in the Government sector. IT Skills: Knowledge of IT/Computer applications including MS Office. Age Limit: Maximum 40 years as on 01-10-2026. HMIS Manager: MBA-IT/ MCA/ M.Sc.-IT/ BCA from recognized institute/ University. Experience: 1-2 years experience in Government or any other reputed organization with exposure to social sector schemes at national, state, and district level. Computer Skills: Computer knowledge including MS Office, MS Word, MS Power Point, and MS Excel; MS access is essential. Age Limit: Maximum 40 years as on 01-10-2026. Desirable: Work experience in health sector including AYUSH and prior experience with Central/State Government. Content Creator: Bachelor of AYUSH degree from a recognized institution. Desirable Qualification: Diploma in Journalism. Additional Skills: Proficiency in preparing and editing medical content, and knowledge of social media platforms and content management. Age Limit: Maximum 40 years as on 01-10-2026. Data Entry Operator: Degree from Recognized University and Govt. of Kerala approved DCA/PGDCA. Additional Qualification: Type writing skills in English & Malayalam. Age Limit: Maximum 40 years as on 01-10-2026. Full Time Sweeper: 7th Pass. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of an interview. In case there are 20 or more applicants for a particular post, a written test will be conducted along with the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after 5:00 PM on 27-10-2026 will be summarily rejected. Applications submitted in any format other than the provided format will be summarily rejected. Applications without copies of certificates will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Incomplete or incorrect application forms will be summarily rejected. Candidates must maintain a personal active E-mail ID and Mobile Number until the completion of the recruitment process. Failure to submit the equivalency certificate will result in rejection of the application. The copy of appointment letters, salary certificates, pay slips, etc., will not be accepted in lieu of work experience certificates. Canvassing in any form will lead to automatic disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in NAM Kerala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NAM Kerala has announced a total of 7 vacancies across various posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 27-10-2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NAM Kerala recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline in a sealed envelope either directly or through post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on 01-10-2026 for all notified posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the State Quality Consultant post?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay for the State Quality Consultant post is Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree from a Recognized University, a Govt. of Kerala approved DCA/PGDCA, and typewriting skills in English and Malayalam.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be a written test for selection?
faq.answer: A written test will be conducted along with the interview only if there are 20 or more applicants for a particular post.

faq.question: Q8. Are these posts permanent or on a contract basis?
faq.answer: These posts under National AYUSH Mission Keralam are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of certificates proving age and educational qualifications, along with an equivalency certificate if applicable.
